objective: Verify fresh Claude Project chats resume from durable project knowledge and an explicit handoff.
scenario: The owner starts a second fresh chat inside Friday — Peanuts. The new chat must identify and use the latest Project handoff and not hallucinate decisions from another conversation that are absent from Project knowledge.
expected_behaviors: State which handoff/document is being used.
Recover approved decisions, current stage, blockers and next action.
Identify missing or conflicting context explicitly.
Ask the owner to add the current handoff to Project knowledge if it is absent.
prohibited_behaviors: Invent a prior decision or claim automatic access to old chat turns.
Treat Claude memory as a replacement for an auditable status record.
